posts.title_en: Rift power display going haywire is too much
posts.summary_en: Screenshot in the Rift: a weapon comparison popup shows +24.3M power with an up arrow, but equipping the raw-attack item lowered the poster's conquest deck power. Commenters attribute the inflated display to the Rift's Dimension Power (차원의 힘).

datapoints.account: Lv.190, profile power 17G 800M 900K (kind not stated, Rift-inflated per comments), rank 941st, blessing (축복) Lv.5, Dimension Power Lv.9, Rift stage 10
datapoints.before: equipped Eternal staff Lv.114 +15: crit rate 45.10%, skill amp 7.93%, crit dmg 16.07%, item power 1.6G
datapoints.after: candidate Eternal staff Lv.117 +15: crit rate 47.15%, attack +719, skill amp 8.60%, item power 1.62G (+24.3M)
datapoints.note: popup says +24.3M; poster says the conquest deck's power dropped after equipping it (no figure given)

damage.text: Swapping crit dmg sub-stat for flat attack (깡공) showed a power gain in the Rift popup but lowered the conquest deck's power.
(comment) Dimension Power inflates displayed power in the Rift, so gear arrows there mislead.

quotes.kr: 토벌 장비 이렇게 뜨길래 진짜 깡공이 좋은건가 싶어서 껴봤는데 토벌덱 투력 떨어짐
quotes.en: Conquest gear showed up like this so I tried it thinking flat attack was really better, but the conquest deck's power dropped

quotes.kr: 차원의 힘 때문에 전투력 뻥튀기 된거
quotes.en: (comment) Power is inflated because of Dimension Power

posts.title_en: [Leak] A guild's conquest stat weights, leaked on leaving
posts.summary_en: Leaked guild-internal conquest stat weights: 1% skill amp = 2% damage, 15% crit rate = 3%, 15% crit dmg = 4%, 650 attack = 2.5%. Flat attack value depends on accumulated totals; individual results vary with break-through, research, gear and stellar link. Commenters say it was already known; one claims a 69t74g score after applying it.

advice.text: (comment) Already known: hit the minimum skill haste, then crit damage.

damage.text: Crit rate +15% = +3% damage; crit damage +15% = +4% damage.
Attack +650 = +2.5% damage; varies with accumulated attack, break-through, research, gear and stellar link.

quotes.en: Each 1% skill amp raises damage 2%
15% crit damage raises it 4%
650 attack raises it 2.5%
